EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a very strong phenyl ring-breathing band at ~1003 cm⁻¹ and aromatic C=C stretches at 1596/1626 cm⁻¹, consistent with a benzene derivative. The band at ~830 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of para-disubstituted benzene, matching an aryl ether bearing a para chloro substituent. Peaks at 695 and 652 cm⁻¹ are consistent with aryl C–Cl stretching modes, and the 1264/1071 cm⁻¹ region fits aryl–O–R (ether) C–O stretching/bending. The CH stretch at 3081 cm⁻¹ is consistent with aromatic/vinylic C–H (supported by GFQ-003). Absence of a strong carbonyl band (~1650–1750 cm⁻¹) rules out carbonyl-containing candidates (1, 2, 4, 7, 10), and the para marker at ~830 cm⁻¹ disfavors monosubstituted aromatic candidates (e.g., 9).
